Who We Are

Make What You Have Work Harder

NOVA is a financial advisory team. We show you where you stand, then make what you already have work harder before suggesting anything new.

Why NOVA? It means "new" in Latin. In the sky, a nova is a star that suddenly shines brighter. We're a young team and a new star rising, here to build something that lasts.

Our Vision

Team NOVA walks with Singapore families through every life stage, from a first salary to retirement and legacy. We give clear advice, recommend only what you need, and stay for the long run.

How It Works

Three simple steps to join the fun.

1. Do Your Review

Complete your End of Year Review 2026 for 1 entry.

2. Refer Someone New

Earn 1 more entry each time someone you refer completes their review.

3. Climb to the Top

Rank #1, #2 or #3 on 23 Dec for boosted grand prize chances.

Key Terms

Who can join?

Anyone who completes a review or refers someone who does. It's free, and no product purchase is needed.

What counts as a referral?

The person must be new to the adviser and not already a client. Their review must be completed and verified by 23 Dec, 11:59pm.

How do the draws work?

Each entry is 1 chance for prizes 4 to 20. For prizes 1 to 3 only, the top three referrers' entries are multiplied by 20, 15 and 10. Ties share the same multiplier.

How many prizes can I win?

Up to 2: one from prizes 4 to 20, and one from prizes 1 to 3.

Is my information public?

Only your masked name, entries and rank. Phone numbers and referred names are never shown.
